items.quote: Fantastic tree removal crew! Great and fair prices too. I'd highly recommend Roy and his guys. Had four other quotes that were either high or sketchy. Great clean up after the job as well.

Personable, hard working, fast and efficient. Roy and his crew are by far the BEST tree service in Marion County. What would have taken another company all day to do they did in a few hours, including clean up. His bid was lower than two other companies that we priced.

Roy and Katie were totally professional removing three giant trees from our yard, working 12hr days over multiple days during rain and heat, they never slowed down. Every bit of debris was removed and the yard has never looked better!
